profile.name: Huynh Quang Tri Nguyen (Bryan)
profile.title: Enterprise Business Development & Fintech Solutions | Master of Business Analytics

about: I am an Enterprise Business Development professional bridging the gap between Data Analytics and commercial execution in Vietnam’s rapidly evolving Fintech and Payment Infrastructure landscape.

Holding a Master’s degree in Business Analytics and a Bachelor’s in International Business from the University of Wollongong, I specialize in consulting payment gateway architectures, omnichannel POS systems, 0% credit card instalment solutions, and automated reconciliation workflows for multi-location enterprises.

My commercial approach is data-grounded: conducting mystery-shopping audits, analyzing merchant unit economics, identifying high-ticket drop-off friction, and delivering tailored B2B proposals that tangibly drive top-line revenue and operational efficiency.
